description: The paper describes laboratory tests using a temperature-controlled oedometer to assess thermal effects on soils around pit thermal energy storage. It discusses compressibility, stiffness, creep, shear strength, moisture and conductivity in geotechnical design. This record covers the source-reported experimental information and design implications, not a released raw measurement table. A poster by the same three authors describes related temperature-controlled soil investigations; overlapping experiment counts and precise sample identity are unknown. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results. The native deposit declares CC-BY-4.0 and public access without a stated charge.
